story-context.title: Customer-Facing Beta Landing Page
story-context.overview: Replace the developer-friendly Test system root page with a customer-facing beta landing page that explains EventLead in customer language, routes visitors to account creation, supports customer discovery follow-up, and is structured for SEO/AEO without overstating production readiness or partially shipped capabilities.

critical-objectives.item: Root route "/" must become customer-facing, not developer/test-environment-facing.
Primary CTA "Create an account" routes to "/signup" and is visible above the fold.
Secondary CTA "See example forms" routes to a safe in-page use-case/examples section unless public examples exist.
Use discovery-aligned positioning: customer engagement forms, operational lens, platform lens, Personas A/B/C.
Include beta trust wording before account creation; do not promise production readiness or automatic migration.
Remove public exposure of API docs, database test, MailHog, backend health, package versions, and local-only instructions from root.
Add SEO/AEO basics: page title, meta description, one H1, logical H2s, crawlable FAQ, useful alt text; JSON-LD if feasible.
Use safe fake visuals/examples only; no internal records, test users, secrets, or developer screenshots.

dependencies.story: Complete. AI/Form Builder foundation is stable enough to pause speculative vision work.
dependencies.doc: Primary product brief and copy source.
Current sequencing: discovery primary, landing page next, Form Builder vision deferred.

constraints.item: Do not run Alembic; this story should not require migrations.
Do not implement image-to-form, new Form Builder capabilities, billing, Stripe, or production infrastructure.
Do not create privacy/compliance/enterprise claims unless already verified.
Do not expose dev-only routes or environment diagnostics on the public root page.

path.note: Root route currently defines developer-oriented HomePage; replace/extract.
CTA target is /signup; do not change auth flow unless necessary.
Login can remain available but secondary to account creation.
Preferred home for new landing page component(s) if created.
Check whether static title/meta should be updated or runtime metadata is enough.
Add targeted tests near the landing component if existing test setup supports it.
